newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Shareholders okay De Boer, Unigro merger.
newsitem.headline: Shareholders okay De Boer, Unigro merger.

text.p: Shareholders of De Boer Winkelbedrijven approved a merger with unlisted Unigro on Wednesday in a deal which creates the second biggest Dutch grocery group with annual sales of 6.4 billion guilders.
The merged De Boer Unigro supermarkets and wholesale group made a proforma net profit of 90.1 million guilders in 1996 and foresees further growth in net profit per share in 1997.
The merger plan was first announced last October and is backdated to January 1, 1997.
Under the terms of the merger, De Boer will acquire all Unigro shares and Unigro's sole shareholder Eric Albada Jelgersma will acquire a 57 percent stake in De Boer Unigro.
He has agreed to reduce his holding to a maximum of 49.9 percent.
